alert_filter: JavaScript uses regression_bug_ids per job mapping
attribution: exact job/repository labels mapped using signatures from up to three latest successful runs within 21 days; retired signatures and historical worker-pool assignments are not inferred
deduplication: union regression_bug_ids across included job/repository configurations
resolutions_window_basis: Bugzilla creation_time in rolling past 365 days
resolution_definition: cached Bugzilla resolution by bug ID; Duplicate is separate from Fixed; missing results are Unknown
